tags: @guarantee ok.full for "http://foo.com/foo?test=123#token" returns protocol "http:", auth "", host "foo.com", pathname "/foo", search "?test=123" and hash "#token"
@guarantee ok.no-protocol for an input with no protocol ("foo.com/foo?test=123#token") returns only pathname "foo.com/foo", search and hash
@guarantee ok.default-proto with `defaultProto` "https://" an input with no protocol is parsed as if it started with it: protocol "https:", host "foo.com", pathname "/foo"

@guarantee ok.split splits `input` at the first "?" and the first "#" into pathname, search (with "?") and hash (with "#"): "http://foo.com/foo?test=123#token" gives "http://foo.com/foo", "?test=123", "#token"
@guarantee ok.split for "username:password" returns username and password, each decoded
@guarantee ok.split returns hostname and port: "foo.com:8080" gives hostname "foo.com" and port "8080"

@guarantee ok.roundtrip joins protocol, auth, host, pathname, search and hash back into a URL: after changing host to "bar.com" in the result of parseURL("http://foo.com/foo?test=123#token") it returns "http://bar.com/foo?test=123#token"
@guarantee ok.last-segment returns the last segment of the path of `input` ("http://example.com/path/to/filename.ext" gives "filename.ext")
@guarantee ok.strict with `strict` true, returns the last segment only when it ends with an extension, else undefined ("/path/to/.hidden-file" gives undefined)
@guarantee ok.pairs parses and decodes "key=value" pairs separated by "&" into an object ("?foo=bar&baz=qux" gives foo "bar" and baz "qux")
@guarantee ok.leading-question accepts the query with or without a leading "?"
@guarantee ok.repeated a key that appears several times gives an array of its values in order ("tags=javascript&tags=web&tags=dev" gives tags ["javascript", "web", "dev"])
@guarantee ok.pair encodes `key` and `value` as "key=value", spaces in the value as "+" ("message", "Hello World" gives "message=Hello+World")
@guarantee ok.array an array value gives one "key=value" pair per element joined by "&" ("tags=javascript&tags=web&tags=dev")
@guarantee ok.pairs encodes each entry of `query` as a query item and joins them with "&" (foo "bar", baz "qux" gives "foo=bar&baz=qux")
@guarantee ok.undefined an entry whose value is undefined is left out (foo "bar", baz undefined gives "foo=bar")
